# Moretta

> Moretta is a private AI chat on Solana. Users sign in with a Solana wallet, chat with the AI model of their choice, make images and videos with dozens of image and video models, compare two to four image models on one prompt, attach their own images to a prompt, research Solana tokens and wallets with an AI agent, and keep their chat history, images, and videos in the browser. Holders of $MORETTA get a tank of free credit that fills by $1 every hour while they hold at least $10 of $MORETTA, up to $24. The app is live at https://app.moretta.ai.

## Docs

- [What is Moretta](what-is-moretta.md): the chat, images (the image models, the aspect ratios, and the price of an image), compare mode (one prompt to two to four image models, with the images side by side), videos (the video models, the lengths, sound, the price of a video, and how long a video takes), attached images (what each mode does with them, the limits, and the price), onchain research, the models, and the wallet sign-in.
- [The tank](tank.md): the line ($10), the hourly fill ($1), the cap ($24), how the app values a holding, and how the chat spends credit on answers, images, compare mode, and videos.
- [Privacy](privacy.md): where chat history, images, attached images, and videos live, what the server keeps while a video is made, what the Moretta server keeps, and the Private and Anonymous model labels.
- [The token](token.md): $MORETTA on Solana, on pump.fun, the contract address, and its official sources.
- [FAQ](faq.md): short answers to common questions.
- [Onchain research](onchain-research.md): the AI agent that reads Solana chain data with read-only tools, at most 6 tools for one question and 60 a day for one wallet. Live: find token, token info, top holders, market, wallet overview, dev check, trading flow (buys, sales, volume, and price change by window, and the latest 100 trades of the main pool with the signs of wash trading), copycat check (tokens with the same ticker or name, the oldest first), social age (the age of the website domain), and a safety report with 11 green, yellow, and red signals (mint and freeze, risky extensions, top 10 wallets, bundled at launch, snipers still hold, largest cluster, fresh wallets, dev wallet, dev history, sell test, liquidity), their thresholds, and a verdict that never calls a token safe. The tools run on the Moretta server, so the data services never see the user. Coming soon: smart money (smart wallets, KOL wallets, wallet PnL, top traders), holder growth, and the age of an X account.
- [Payments](payments.md): free credit from the tank, and the next development: private top-ups on Starknet, anonymous vouchers, pay with SOL or ZEC, and private billing.
